policy.authority: PTO ASL, accepted architecture decisions, and this identity catalog define the numeric profile boundary; backend behavior is evidence only.
policy.support_boundary: A target profile may reject an operation/type tuple, but it may not silently change the portable result of an accepted tuple.
policy.bounded_variation: A portable rule may delegate a result dimension only to a named target profile or visible numeric mode with a finite or mathematically testable allowed-result contract.
policy.unknown_selection: Unknown identities, modes, formats, operation/type tuples, and missing delegated rules reject before architectural effects.
policy.cpu_observation: CPU observations are implementation-under-test diagnostics and are never an architectural profile or independent oracle.

identities.role: Portable result, legality, and pre-effect rejection contract for accepted numeric operation/type tuples.
identities.selection: Applies to every PTO numeric operation; target profiles may only narrow support or implement an explicitly delegated bounded variation point.
identities.relation_to_pto_v0: Distinct from the deterministic pto-v0 raw-carrier implementation profile; it supplies the future target-conformance contract rather than changing pto-v0.

identities.role: Versioned implementation-under-test observations and developer diagnostics.
identities.selection: Cannot be selected as an architectural numeric profile or independent conformance oracle.
identities.relation_to_pto_v0: May observe pto-v0 or a CPU backend but defines neither one.

identities.role: A2A3 support restrictions and explicitly delegated bounded numeric rules.
identities.selection: Requires a complete A2A3 operation/type legality matrix and one accepted result rule for every supported tuple.
identities.relation_to_pto_v0: Future alternative target profile distinct from pto-v0; pto-v0 raw-carrier results are not inherited as hardware arithmetic.

identities.role: A5 support restrictions and explicitly delegated bounded numeric rules.
identities.selection: Requires a complete A5 operation/type legality matrix and one accepted result rule for every supported tuple.
identities.relation_to_pto_v0: Future alternative target profile distinct from pto-v0; pto-v0 raw-carrier results are not inherited as hardware arithmetic.
